This page captures the product backlog grooming snapshot and priorities across multiple projects as of July 10, 2026. It outlines the immediate P0 requirements for [Aurora](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md) and [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md), shared icebox items, quick wins, and explicitly rejected stale ideas.
